description: Get the payment details for an order made with create_pickup_order. No wallet is set up in this server, so it pays nothing: for an x402 order it returns the USDC price and pay link for another x402 client to pay; for a card order, the checkout link for the user to pay on.

order_id.description: The order id create_pickup_order returned, like "ord_7HkQ2mXc9aRt".

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

name: pay_order
title: Pay for an order
